params.code: local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); assert(t.PieceY < 17, 'piece did not fall'); return t.PieceY
local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); assert(t:PieceLeft() == 0, 'piece not at the left wall: ' .. t:PieceLeft()); return t:PieceLeft()

local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); assert(t:FilledCells() == 4, 'expected 4 locked cells, got ' .. t:FilledCells()); assert(t.Score > 0, 'hard drop did not score'); return t.Score

local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); assert(not t.GameOver, 'unexpected game over'); assert(t:FilledCells() % 4 == 0 and t:FilledCells() > 4, 'pieces did not stack: ' .. t:FilledCells()); return 'score=' .. t.Score .. ' filled=' .. t:FilledCells()
local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); assert(t.Score == 0 and t:FilledCells() == 0 and not t.GameOver, 'restart did not reset'); return 'reset ok'

local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); for x = 0, t.Width - 1 do t.Board[x + 1] = 'I' end; while t:Move(0, -1) do end; t:Lock(); assert(t.Lines == 1, 'expected 1 line, got ' .. t.Lines); assert(t:FilledCells() == 4, 'the row was not removed: ' .. t:FilledCells()); local burst = Scene.FindEntityByName('LineBurst'); assert(burst:GetParticleCount() == t.BurstParticles, 'line burst: ' .. burst:GetParticleCount()); assert(burst.Translation.y == 0, 'burst away from the cleared row'); assert(t.Trauma > 0, 'no shake'); return t.Trauma

local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); assert(t.Trauma == 0, 'trauma left: ' .. t.Trauma); local n = Scene.FindEntityByName('LineBurst'):GetParticleCount(); assert(n == 0, n .. ' sparks left'); return 'settled'

local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); t:Reset(); for i = 1, 4 * t.Width do t.Board[i] = 'I' end; while t:Move(0, -1) do end; t:Lock(); assert(t.Lines == 4 and t.Score == 800, 'tetris: ' .. t.Lines .. ' lines, score ' .. t.Score); assert(t.Trauma == 1, 'a tetris shakes hardest: ' .. t.Trauma); local n = Scene.FindEntityByName('LineBurst'):GetParticleCount(); assert(n == 4 * t.BurstParticles, n .. ' sparks'); return n

local t = Scene.FindEntityByName('Tetris'):GetScript(); for x = 0, t.Width - 1 do t.Board[x + 1] = 'I' end; while t:Move(0, -1) do end; t:Lock(); assert(t.Lines == 5, 'lines ' .. t.Lines); assert(t.Trauma == 1, 'trauma above full: ' .. t.Trauma); return t.Trauma
